revision_disclosure: Revision 1 was evaluated on the already-seen holdout and failed energy/generation/structure thresholds. Revision 2 separates electricity activity elasticity using ONLY 2005-2014 data and corrects initial project margin accounting. Same calibration grid, scales and thresholds retained. This is a disclosed post-evaluation structural revision, never a blind validation.

assumptions.gdp_future_basis: Author conditional deceleration path, not official forecast; paired +/-1 percentage point and joint range
assumptions.initial_cash_basis: Two years of reference construction capacity; reconstructed financing endowment, not observed company accounts
assumptions.income_basis: Service-income endowment covers energy purchases; financing inflows and internal transfers are recorded separately from national resource costs
assumptions.initial_pipeline_basis: Equal annual commissioning over lead time from trailing three-year net capacity additions, using only initial-year-and-earlier snapshots; no observed future additions
assumptions.initial_generation_cohorts: Uniform residual age over economic lifetime for pre-2009 stock; later positive observed net additions are separate cohorts; proxy for unavailable asset census
assumptions.initial_device_cohorts: Uniform 1..15 remaining years; output capacities reconstructed from initial useful-service demand and 60% duty; no plant/device census claim
assumptions.electricity_activity_elasticity: Zero-intercept log growth fit against real GDP, 2005-2014 only, after declared intensity trend; separate from calibrated direct-fuel service elasticity
assumptions.archetype_warning: Fuel residuals are aggregate service proxies, not observed sector allocation; source sector tables include transformation and are not summed as final use
assumptions.nonenergy_warning: Initial non-energy fractions are assumptions, kept in primary energy and excluded from combustion; IPPU uses separate BTR bridge; inspect +/-50%
assumptions.fuel_capacity_warning: Annual averages x explicit peak-deliverability headroom are engineering bounds, not observed hourly delivery rates
assumptions.renewable_tariff_basis: Explicit historical supported-price reconstruction, declining linearly to the 2021 common reference. Not a recovered province/project subsidy schedule; +/-20% structural check. Added after 2015-16 mechanical smoke test and before train search/holdout evaluation.
assumptions.price_warning: Constant real 2024 CNY reference prices; 449 originates in 2022 coal market mean and is an explicit all-technology tariff proxy, not universal actual settlement
assumptions.chronology_warning: Deterministic representative day, perfect information within 24h, cyclic state; no seasonal adequacy or probabilistic reliability conclusion
assumptions.storage_warning: 2024 announced new-type storage scale needs original-row match; 2014 new-type storage excluded by simplification (not an observation of zero); pumped-storage capacity remains in reported hydro with net energy budget
assumptions.other_cost_warning: Hydro/oil/biomass capex and solar/hydro fixed O&M are author engineering assumptions; +/-30% joint financial stress test
assumptions.ets_warning: Output-based free-allocation archetypes; 2021-2025 benchmarks are sensitivity assumptions, not exact historical compliance; 2026 large-coal/gas source values applied only from publication year, then held real; no supply/heat/peak corrections or banked allowances; industry expansion only in process sensitivity
assumptions.primary_bridge: Separate NBS fossil tce and initial PEO-to-noncombustion generation factor; hold factor within each experiment. Forecast nonfossil factor anchored to 2024 19.8% reference; report +/-10% bridge envelope, not exact official accounting
assumptions.carbon_bridge_warning: BTR2021 process+waste extended by GDP^0.5 and 2% intensity decline; net CO2 land removals held at 1.346499 Gt; no negative-emission technology assumed. 2005 same BTR CO2 baseline. Not all-GHG neutrality
assumptions.biomass_warning: Biogenic combustion treated as inventory memo item; feedstock finite, no negative emissions; not a lifecycle carbon-neutrality assertion
